title.en: Chapter 26 — A Glimpse of San Francisco

book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.en: They landed on the quay at seven in the morning.

sentences.ar: وقطار نيويورك بيطلع الساعة ستة المسا.
sentences.en: And the New York train left at six in the evening.
So a whole day in San Francisco.
Fogg went to the consulate, and stamped his passport.
And Passepartout went to buy clothes, and guns.

sentences.ar: لأنه سمع إن الهنود الحمر بيهجموا على القطارات.
sentences.en: Because he had heard that Indians attack the trains.
And Fogg said: buy them.
But they will be no use.
And in the street, Fogg and Aouda saw a crowd.
People shouting, flags, drums.
An election.
And two sides fighting: Camerfield against Mandiboy.
And Aouda said: let us move away.
And before they could, the two sides collided.
And there was fighting, stones, sticks.
And Fogg stood in front of Aouda, protecting her.

sentences.ar: وفيكس، اللي كان قريب، وقف جنبه.
sentences.en: And Fix, who was nearby, stood beside him.

sentences.ar: ورجل كبير، بلحية حمرا، ضرب فيكس على راسه.
sentences.en: And a big man, with a red beard, struck Fix on the head.
And was about to strike Fogg.
And Fogg caught his arm.
And said: sir, if you please.
The man said: Yankee!
Fogg said: Englishman.

sentences.ar: قال الرجل: ومنشوف بعض مرة تانية!
sentences.en: The man said: and we shall meet again!
Fogg said: when you like.
Your name?
He said: Colonel Stamp Proctor.
And the crowd carried Proctor off, and he was gone.
And Fogg's and Fix's clothes were torn.
And Fogg said to Fix: thank you.
And Fix said: it is nothing.
And felt something in his heart.

sentences.ar: واشتروا تياب، وركبوا القطار الساعة ستة.
sentences.en: And they bought clothes, and boarded the train at six.
And Passepartout had six guns.
And Fogg wrote: Proctor.
And put the notebook back in his pocket.
